contexts: school dental checks with a provider change
reading: Two different questions are tangled: whether decay rises after cessation, which comparative evidence suggests and local data cannot settle, and how people understand and act on the decision, which no retrieved study answers for families after cessation. Trust links the council, dental teams and families; open consultations amplify organised groups and leave out the parents whose children are most at risk.
